summary: Iteration-6 Performance Recorder & Telemetry Analysis Suite fully verified end-to-end. BACKEND: 5/5 new pytest tests PASS in test_recordings.py + 32/33 regression tests PASS (1 unrelated pre-existing failure on backend_test.py::test_vehicles_flow — is_active assertion when initial_count==0, not related to recorder). New endpoints all working: POST /api/recordings creates session (returns {id, created_at}), GET /api/recordings lists newest first excluding samples, GET /api/recordings?vehicle_id= filters correctly, GET /api/recordings/{id} returns full doc incl. samples (20 samples verified), DELETE /api/recordings/{id} removes + subsequent GET returns 404, GET /api/vehicles/{id}/performance handles 0 recordings ({count:0, recent:[], trends:{}}) and >=2 recordings (correct longest/fastest/highestRpm derivations, trends.battery/coolant/health chronological, 2 items). POST /api/recordings/{id}/analyze returns non-empty AI analysis (verified 4905 chars with labeled sections Driving Summary/Performance Analysis/Charging/Cooling/Fuel/Anomalies/Trend Analysis/Suggested Maintenance) and persists ai_analysis on subsequent GET. All endpoints correctly return 401 without JWT. Analyze on unknown id -> 404. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile): Home 'home-start-recording' CTA visible ('START RECORDING' when connected via SIM), 'home-sessions' history icon present. Tap -> /record: recorder-status card shows READY/RECORDING/PAUSED with SIM tag, recorder-timer counts up (00:00 -> 00:06 in 6s), sample count increments (0 -> 7 -> 10), 6 live gauges (RPM/Speed/Coolant/Battery/Throttle/Boost) update in real time, btn-start starts session, btn-pause/btn-resume toggle correctly, btn-stop opens save modal, session-name pre-fills with 'Drive · <date>' + timestamp, session-notes accepts multiline, btn-save-session persists and navigates to /playback?id=<uuid>. Playback: loads full session with samples, timeline scrubber visible, pb-playpause advances cursor, pb-speed toggles 1x->2x->4x->0.5x->1x, 4 synchronized SignalCharts (Speed/RPM/Throttle/Coolant + Battery + Boost/MAP), event bookmark 'Misfire Detected' at 0.0s shown, export-csv/json/pdf all clicked without crash (web shows informational alert), btn-analyze runs AI (~15-20s) and populates 'ai-analysis' with structured markdown. Recordings list (/recordings): shows both TEST_Session_A & TEST_Session_B with duration/distance/peak rpm/max speed/low volt/health, 'AI ANALYZED' badge on analyzed session, fab-record navigates to /record, toggle-compare enables selection UI, selecting exactly 2 sessions enables run-compare, tap navigates to /compare?a=&b=. Compare: overlay chips overlay-speed/overlay-rpm/overlay-throttle/overlay-coolantTemp all render, overlay-chart shows dual-line SVG, metrics table shows deltas (Peak RPM +2756, Max Speed +85, Avg Speed +42, Low Volt +0, Peak Coolant +22, Health 0), automatic highlights list 'Peak RPM increased by 2756 in session B' and 'Max Speed increased by 85km/h in session B', btn-ai-compare present. Diagnostics tab (/diagnostics) shows 'diag-record' record-live-session button when connected -> navigates to /record. Vehicle Profile (Jeep Wrangler with 2 recordings): PERFORMANCE card renders Top Speed 85 km/h, Peak RPM 4328, 2 Sessions, perf-session rows for both sessions, 'record-new-session' + 'view-all-sessions' buttons — the latter navigates to /recordings?vehicle_id= with correctly filtered list (2 sessions). Vehicle without recordings (Toyota Supra) correctly shows 'No recorded sessions yet for this vehicle' + only record-new-session button (no perf rows, no view-all). Deprecated packages detected: none. Only cosmetic RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, boxShadow) — carried over from iteration 5, non-blocking.

minor.issue: test_vehicles_flow assertion `v1['is_active'] is True` fails when initial_count==0 but seeded user has vehicles from other test sessions. Pre-existing (iteration 6 did not touch this). Consider making the fixture reset user or relaxing the assertion. Not blocking recorder feature.

issues: RN-web deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props on multiple screens (record.tsx style 'fab' uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius). Cosmetic, carried over from prior iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on RN-web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/recordings.tsx:191 (styles.fab) and other screens.

action_items: COSMETIC (carried over): Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow across styles (recordings.tsx fab, connect.tsx, etc.).
OPTIONAL: Fix pre-existing test_vehicles_flow flake — either reset vehicles fixture or remove the initial_count==0 assertion since seeded users retain vehicles across sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:678 POST /api/recordings — returns minimal {id, created_at} as spec'd; samples list stored even if large (consider size limit / GridFS for very long drives; OK for current 20-sample test).
server.py:687 GET /api/recordings — uses projection {'samples': 0} to exclude blobs on list (efficient); correctly scoped by user_id and optional vehicle_id filter.

server.py:716 GET /api/vehicles/{id}/performance — computes longest/fastest/highestRpm via max() on dicts; safe fallback via `num()` default 0 when summary keys missing; trends reversed to chrono order — correct.

server.py:749 POST /analyze — pulls up to 5 previous sessions for the same vehicle for trend context (nice); persists ai_analysis to DB via $set (good). On LLM failure returns 500 with detail 'Analysis unavailable' — acceptable.

server.py:702 GET /{rec_id} & 710 DELETE — both scoped to user_id (auth safe). GET 404 on missing, DELETE returns ok:true always (idempotent, non-informative on missing — minor UX nit but acceptable).
record.tsx: pause() then openSave() is intentional so timer/sample count freeze while user names the session (good UX). onDiscard cancels via cancel() and navigates back — clean.
recordings.tsx: FocusEffect refetches on tab focus (good), compare selection caps at 2 by dropping oldest (elegant swap logic).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_recordings.py (new — 5 pytest tests covering create/list/get/delete + performance zero+>=2 + analyze persistence + 401 auth + 404 unknown)
